summary: Iteration 4: Add/delete properties with contacts, Ashik admin login, user role/password/name/phone edits, header-home-button on stack screens — all verified. Backend: 10/10 new tests pass in test_iteration4.py (plus prior 63 regression tests still green). Coverage — Ashik: POST /api/auth/login with ashik.ma@britsmaid.in/Britsmaid2026@ashik returns role=admin + token. Properties: POST /api/properties persists owner_alt_phone, owner_address, contacts[]; GET round-trips 3 contacts with mixed roles (Caretaker, Co-owner, Emergency contact) and emergency flag; PUT appends a 4th contact and updates owner_address; DELETE flips is_deleted and removes from GET /api/properties. Users: PUT /api/users/{id} role switches cleaner->admin->cleaner, promote to owner requires property_ids (400 without, 200 with), switching away from owner clears property_ids to []; new password invalidates old (401) and the new one logs in (200); name & phone update persisted; admin cannot change own role (400) and remains admin. All 10 tests use new TEST_* users/villas and clean up after themselves — seeded accounts not modified. Frontend (390x844 mobile, Ashik logged in): Villas tab shows add-property-button, property card -> property/[id] renders property-contacts-card (Owner section with call/whatsapp icons visible; empty-state 'No emergency or other contacts yet' when none), property-edit-bottom, property-delete-bottom and header-home-button. property/edit shows contact-add-button, header-home-button and property-delete-from-edit. Contact sheet (contact-sheet) exposes role chips (Co-owner, Family member, Emergency contact, Caretaker, Property manager, Local contact, Security, Maintenance, Other), contact-name-input, contact-phone-input, contact-emergency-toggle, contact-save-button. header-home-button is auto-rendered by the shared Header whenever `back` is set, so it is present on property/[id], property/edit, staff, cleaning/[id], booking/new, invoice/[id], invoice/new, report/[id], report/new, report/settlement, and owner/[id]. Dashboard dashboard-team-card -> /staff shows staff-add-button, staff-invite-<id>, staff-remove-<id>; tapping a staff-<id> row opens assign-sheet with edit-role (Cleaner|Villa owner|Admin), edit-name-input, edit-phone-input, edit-password-input (secure) and assign-save-button. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1276 lines — still well above the 700-line guideline. Property/user routers add new fields but overall file keeps growing; splitting into routers (users, properties, bookings, cleaning, reports, payouts, sync) would help maintenance.

update_user() has a dead branch at lines 312-313 (`if body.property_ids is not None and u['role'] != 'owner' and 'role' in changes: pass`) — the condition is only truthy when role was just set to a non-owner value, in which case the elif cannot run anyway. The `pass` is a no-op; the logic is correct but the branch can be simplified/removed for clarity.
PropertyIn.contacts has no server-side bound on list length; a hostile admin could POST thousands of contacts. Consider `Field(max_length=50)` or similar.

DELETE /api/properties/{pid} soft-deletes with is_deleted=True but does not revoke owner.property_ids references — if the sole villa of an owner is deleted, the owner retains a dangling pid and their list_properties returns []. Consider pulling the pid from all owners when a property is deleted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all testIDs mentioned in the review request are present and reachable on mobile viewport
